goal: Compare three synthetic supplier quotes and recommend the lowest-cost supplier that meets the delivery limit.
inputText: Use the supplied fixture in the isolated browser. Set the delivery limit to 7 days and click Compare quotes. Report every supplier's total and eligibility, then recommend the eligible supplier with the lowest total. Do not place an order or send messages.
acceptanceCriteria: All three quotes are included; total equals quantity times unit price plus shipping, in integer cents.
Only suppliers delivering within 7 days are eligible.
The recommendation is the eligible supplier with the smallest total; no purchase is executed.
